title: The Last Will
author: August Dunmore
blurb: Kestrel Crane, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
